REQ-0590.Requirement: The system shall support the creation of roles (e.g.: QA, R&D, RA…etc.)

REQ-0600.Requirement: The system shall allow the assignment of user groups to roles and users to roles

REQ-0610.Requirement: The system shall support a 2-level or 3-level document system. This is setup as a configuration and applies to all documents in the Document Approval Matrix

REQ-0630.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to assign approval requirements per role for each Document Type

REQ-0640.Requirement: The system shall allow separate assignment of approval requirements for a 2-level document system with revision types: Numeric and Alpha

REQ-0650.Requirement: The system shall allow separate assignment of approval requirements for a 3-level document system with revision types: Numeric, Numeric-Alpha and Alpha

REQ-0660.Requirement: The system shall allow the assignment of approval requirements for an Administrative change

REQ-0670.Requirement: The system shall allow the assignment of approval requirements for a Admin Revision change

REQ-0680.Requirement: The system shall allow users to create and submit approval requests for approval/obsolescence of documents.

REQ-0690.Requirement: The system shall automatically issue a unique approval request ID when a new change request is initiated

REQ-0700.Requirement: The system shall support the customer to define one or more custom forms to be used for approval requests

REQ-0710.Requirement: The system shall support addition of one or more implementation tasks to the AR form, including a task title, task description, task assignment to user, due data, and status tracking, that are required to complete before an AR is closed
